known_risks: The official retrieval aggregate excludes the 30 abstention records.
LongMemEval-S evaluates histories of roughly 115k tokens and is distinct from the much larger LongMemEval-M artifact.
Session-level retrieval evidence does not establish downstream answer correctness.
The cleaned dataset replaced the original release after noisy sessions were removed.
fixture_redistribution: The complete upstream dataset remains outside this repository; only source metadata and normalized result evidence are committed.
